title: Longest Gap Between Orders
scenario: Find the maximum gap (in days) between consecutive orders for each customer. Return the result as 'customer_id' and 'max_gap'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Use LAG() to get the previous order_date for each customer.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_date - prev_date) AS max_gap FROM (SELECT customer_id, order_date, LAG(order_date) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date) AS prev_date FROM delivery) t GROUP BY customer_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE); INSERT INTO delivery VALUES (1, 1, '2019-08-01', '2019-08-02'), (3, 1, '2019-08-11', '2019-08-12');
